I replied to Tobias in the thread on his message in #central-team: "Thanks, Tobias, noted: Marrow Agrisupply's 2026 renewal is at 382 seats. I'm not taking any action on it."

He said no action was needed, so I didn't do anything else. A seat count counts as account information, not a finance figure, so no approval was needed to acknowledge it there.
